purpose: Test listener comprehension and immediate recall of matched speech versions, separately from learner teachability and from claims about trust, persuasion or behavior.
claim_boundary: A result can show differences in the measured listener task under this protocol. It cannot establish that a celebrity's delivery caused trust, long-term memory, persuasion, engagement or action in general.

design.comparison: randomized matched control versus pattern-informed version with the same proposition, topic, length range and factual content
design.assignment: randomize version order and pattern order within participant; keep scorer blind to condition where practical
design.holdout: Use new locally authored stimuli not copied from the source speeches; reserve a stimulus set until analysis is locked.

patterns.communication_job: show a change or distinction without inferring motive
patterns.stimulus_requirement: matched short speech pair; no personal disclosure required

patterns.communication_job: make an abstract claim concrete without treating an example as proof
patterns.stimulus_requirement: matched short speech pair; no personal disclosure required

patterns.communication_job: use bounded personal detail without making it universal
patterns.stimulus_requirement: matched short speech pair; no personal disclosure required

patterns.stimulus_requirement: matched short speech pair; no personal disclosure required

patterns.communication_job: mark a takeaway and preserve its limit
patterns.stimulus_requirement: matched short speech pair; no personal disclosure required

patterns.communication_job: invite clarification or reflection without pressure
patterns.stimulus_requirement: matched short speech pair; no personal disclosure required

patterns.communication_job: make a term precise without overclaiming
patterns.stimulus_requirement: matched short speech pair; no personal disclosure required

patterns.communication_job: make an optional action specific and bounded
patterns.stimulus_requirement: matched short speech pair; no personal disclosure required

listener_tasks.prompt: State the speaker's main point in your own words without seeing the script.
Name the example, reason or evidence the speaker used, if any.
State one limit, uncertainty or condition the speaker included, or say that none was clear.
What action, if any, did the speaker invite? Include owner or condition if stated.
Report what was confusing, rushed, emotionally difficult or easy to follow; do not require agreement.
After a defined delay, restate the main point and one supporting detail.
listener_tasks.measure: blind rubric score 0–2; only if delay and consent are feasible

controls: Keep proposition, topic, vocabulary, length and reading/listening modality matched.
Do not use source celebrity identity as the experimental manipulation.
Pretest readability, caption quality and accessibility before data collection.
Record whether a participant already knew the topic and whether they agreed with it.
Treat agreement, trust and liking as separate optional measures, never as comprehension proxies.
consent_and_accessibility: Use plain-language consent and allow withdrawal without penalty.
Offer text, captioned audio/video and screen-reader-compatible response modes.
Do not require trauma, medical, political or personal disclosures.
Minimize retention of recordings; obtain separate permission for any recording.
analysis_plan: Report item-level and aggregate comprehension/recall with uncertainty; do not average away missingness or accessibility failures.
Compare pattern-informed versus control within stimulus and, where possible, within participant.
Inspect null results, reversals and condition-by-topic interactions.
Pre-register primary task and exclusion rules before unblinding condition labels.
Treat any result as local to the authored stimuli and tested population until replicated.
not_run_reason: The repository contains no consented listener observations or locked matched stimulus set yet.
